```{r}
#| output: False
#| warning: False
# Load in packages
library(tidyverse) # data cleaning and visualization
library(sf) # spatial data
library(terra) # raster
library(tmap) # map making 
library(stars) # spatiotemporal array
```

# Load in Data
```{r}
#| output: False
# Load light data (rasters)
feb_7_h5 <- read_stars("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif")
feb_7_h6 <- read_stars("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif")
feb_16_h5 <- read_stars("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif")
feb_16_h6 <- read_stars("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif")

# Subset using a SQL query for just highways
roads_query <- "SELECT * FROM gis_osm_roads_free_1 WHERE fclass='motorway'"

# Load highways data
highways <- st_read("data/gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg", query=roads_query) # vector

# Subset using a SQL query for homes
houses_query <- "SELECT * 
FROM gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1
WHERE (type IS NULL AND name IS NULL)
OR type in ('residential', 'apartments', 'house', 'static_caravan', 'detached')"

# Load houses data
houses <- st_read("data/gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg", query=houses_query) # vector
```

# Check CRS
```{r}
# Before merge, check that CRS match
st_crs(highways) == st_crs(houses)
st_crs(feb_7_h5) == st_crs(feb_16_h5)
st_crs(feb_7_h6) == st_crs(feb_16_h6)
```

# Check Extents
```{r}
# Extents match for h5 area
if(all(st_bbox(feb_7_h5) == st_bbox(feb_16_h5))){
  print("extents match")
} else{
  warning("extents do not match")
}

# Extents match for h6 area
if(all(st_bbox(feb_7_h6) == st_bbox(feb_16_h6))){
  print("extents match")
} else{
  warning("extents do not match")
}
```

# Merge Stars Data with St_Mosaic
```{r}
# Combine using stars package attribute
houston_pre_storm <- st_mosaic(feb_7_h5, feb_7_h6)
houston_post_storm <- st_mosaic(feb_16_h5, feb_16_h6)
```

# Check after merge that all match
```{r}
# Double check extents match after merge
if(all(st_bbox(houston_pre_storm) == st_bbox(houston_post_storm))){
  print("extents match")
} else{
  warning("extents do not match")
}

# Double check CRS match after merge
if(st_crs(houston_pre_storm) == st_crs(houston_post_storm)){
  print("CRS match")
} else{
  warning("CRS does not match")
}
```

# Reclassify Difference between Pre-and-Post Storm and Crop to Blackout 
```{r}
# Calculate light intensity difference pre and post storm
houston_diff <- rast(houston_pre_storm) - rast(houston_spost_torm)

# Assign NA to all locations that experienced a drop of less than 200 nW cm-2sr-1 change
blackout_mask <- classify(houston_diff, matrix(
    c(-Inf, 200, NA, # No blackout
      200, Inf, 1   # Blackout
    ),
    ncol = 3,
    byrow = TRUE))

# Vectorize the blackout mask 
blackout_vector <- st_as_stars(blackout_mask) |> 
  st_as_sf() |> # convert from a raster to a vector
  st_make_valid() # fix any invalid geometries 

# Define Houston bounding box
houston_bbox <- st_bbox(c(xmin = -96.5, ymin = 29,
                          xmax = -94.5, ymax = 30.5),
                          crs = st_crs(feb_7_h5))

# Crop to Houston bounding box and reproject to EPSG:3083
blackout_houston <- st_crop(blackout_vector, houston_bbox) |> 
  st_transform(crs = 'EPSG:3083')
```

# Compare Night Light Intensities for Pre-and-Post Storms
```{r}
# Crop pre-and-post storm to Houston bounding box
pre_crop <- st_crop(houston_pre_storm, houston_bbox) 
post_crop <- st_crop(houston_post_storm, houston_bbox) 

# Plot of light intensity before and after storms 
light_merge <- c(pre_crop, storm_crop)
names(light_merge) <- c("2-07-2021", "2-16-2021")

# Maps comparing night light intensities
tm_shape(light_merge) + 
  tm_raster(
    col.scale = tm_scale_continuous_log1p(values = "magma"),
    col.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "Night light radiance (nW/cm²/sr)",
      orientation = "landscape"
    ) , col.free = FALSE
  ) + 
  tm_facets_wrap(nrow = 1) +
  tm_title("Houston, TX Light Intensity Pre-and-Post February 2021 Storms") +
  tm_compass(position = c("left", "bottom"), size = 0.5) +
  tm_scalebar(position = tm_pos_out("center", "bottom"))
```

These two maps highlight the overall difference in the city night light radiance (nW/cm²/sr) for pre-and-post storms. This shows that overall radiance descreased after the storm since the second map is more sparse.

# Remove Highway Buffer from Blackout Map
```{r}
# Reproject highways and create 200m buffer
highways <- st_transform(highways, crs = 'EPSG:3083')
highway_buffer <- highways |> # Highways experienced changes in their night light intensities unrelated to the storm
  st_union() |> # st_union() to combine geometries within each group
  st_buffer(dist = 200)

# Take away highway buffers from blackout areas
blackout_final <- st_difference(blackout_houston, highway_buffer)
```

# Number of Homes That Experienced Power Outages
```{r}
# Filter the houses that relate to blackout area
blackout_houses <- st_transform(houses, crs = "EPSG:3083") |> 
  st_filter(blackout_final) # identify homes that overlap with areas that experienced blackouts

# Houses affected by blackout
n_blackout_houses <- nrow(blackout_houses) # 157409 houses
```

Based on this analysis, 157,409 homes experiences a power outage from the February 2021 storms.

# Map of Houston Homes That Experienced Power Outages in 2021 Storms
```{r}
# Final map output of the homes with power outages
tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap.HOT") + 
  tm_shape(blackout_houses) + # Homes where power was lost
  tm_polygons(size = 0.05, fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_add_legend(labels = 'Blackout Areas', position = c("bottom", "right")) +
  tm_scalebar(position = c("bottom", "left")) + # Add scalebar and compass
  tm_compass(position = c("top", "right")) +
  tm_title("Houston Homes That Experienced Power Outages")
```

# Results Summary
The map highlights areas of Houston that experienced power outages during the storm in 2021. Highway buffers of 200 meters were removed because outages near major roadways were not representative of residential power outages. The blackout raster was then filtered to identify areas where homes experienced a loss of power. Results show that outages were primarily concentrated in the northwestern region of Houston. While this analysis identifies the spatial distribution of power outages, it does not examine the environmental justice implications of these disruptions. Future analysis should investigate whether the frequency and duration of outages differed across neighborhoods and whether vulnerable communities experienced disproportionate impacts.
